tasks.DistinctLettersNeeded: Determine the number of distinct letters needed for 2-letter combinations
tasks.LetterCombinations: Calculate the number of distinct letter combinations using both uppercase and lowercase letters
tasks.NumberCombinations: Calculate the number of possible 2-digit numbers
tasks.TotalBikeNumbers: Multiply the results from tasks LetterCombinations and NumberCombinations to get total bike numbers
